The ketogenic diet is internationally recognized as the first-line treatment; the earlier it is started, the better the prognosis.
It can effectively control seizures and improve motor disorders.
Antiepileptic drug treatment is generally ineffective or provides limited symptom improvement before starting the ketogenic diet.
